methodology.description: Fundamentals-only score; daily macro/theme research does not mechanically alter ratings.

holdings.name: ExxonMobil
holdings.strength: Strong cash generation, balance sheet and capital returns.
holdings.weakness: Commodity-cycle exposure remains the main constraint.
holdings.verdict: High-quality integrated energy anchor; no score change.

holdings.name: CTOS Digital Berhad
holdings.strength: Recurring credit-data demand and strong cash conversion.
holdings.weakness: Growth has moderated; regional execution needs to reaccelerate.
holdings.verdict: Quality remains intact; no score change.

holdings.name: IOI Properties Group Berhad
holdings.status: FY26 reset confirms stronger underlying earnings
holdings.strength: Underlying PBT rose 91%, all core segments grew and record unbilled sales improve visibility; Singapore occupancy and the proposed REIT add recurring-income/capital-recycling optionality.
holdings.weakness: Leverage remains the key constraint and headline profit still contains material remeasurement/fair-value gains.
holdings.verdict: Upgrade 74 provisional to 78/B. FY26 validates a stronger operating base, but leverage prevents B+ until asset recycling improves the balance sheet and recurring cash flow.

holdings.name: YTL Power International Berhad
holdings.strength: Power, regulated water, telecom and data-centre assets provide strong infrastructure optionality.
holdings.weakness: Heavy capex, negative free cash flow and leverage remain substantial.
holdings.verdict: Keep 71/B pending clearer AI-cloud/data-centre cash conversion.

holdings.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
holdings.status: Elite franchise, weak current cash economics
holdings.strength: Exceptional IP portfolio and GTA VI scale opportunity.
holdings.weakness: Current profitability/cash flow remain weak relative to valuation.

holdings.name: Tesla
holdings.status: Balance sheet strong; valuation outruns current earnings
holdings.strength: Exceptional balance sheet and scaling energy storage with autonomy/robotics optionality.
holdings.weakness: Core auto margins are low relative to valuation and AI/autonomy success is heavily capitalised in advance.

holdings.name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Berhad
holdings.status: Income support remains; earnings momentum weak
holdings.strength: Healthier balance sheet, offshore maintenance/OSV exposure and dividends retain cyclical optionality.
holdings.weakness: Latest revenue and profit contracted sharply year on year.
holdings.verdict: No score change; do not average down until operations stabilise.
